question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the highlighted group of words in the given sentence.

We had to study __a poem of lamentation, especially for the dead__, written by Thomas Gray.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Elegy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Elegy"** refers to a poem of serious reflection, typically a lament for the dead. (शोकगीत)

 
 
• **Example:** Thomas Gray's "Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard" is a famous example of an **elegy**.
 
 
 
• **Explanation of Elegy:** It is a form of literature that expresses sorrow or mourning, often for someone who has passed away. (शोकपूर्ण कविता)
 
 
• **Example:** The poet composed an elegy to honour the memory of his late friend.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Elegy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Essay** (निबंध): A short piece of writing on a particular subject.

 
 
• **Example:** He wrote an **essay** about the environmental challenges of our time.
 
 
 
• **Report** (रिपोर्ट): A detailed account or statement about a particular matter, often based on observation or investigation.
 
 
• **Example:** The journalist filed a **report** on the recent political developments.
 
 
 
• **Account** (विवरण): A narrative or record of events or experiences.
 
 
• **Example:** His **account** of the trip was full of vivid descriptions.
